text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The international community should penalise the former rebel UNITA movement if it did not complete its obligations in a peace plan to end two decades of civil war, Angola's Public Works Minister Pedro de Castro van Dunem said on a visit to Lisbon.
- Algerian Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia left Angola after a two-day visit in which he held talks with President Jose Eduardo dos Santos and other senior government officials.
- The Angolan government congratulated U.S. President Bill Clinton on his re-election.
